notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
New levels and new adventures and quests, the game has 20 levels!
Added jump levels and levels in which you have to solve puzzles interacting with physical objects! As in life, the higher the jump, the stronger the impact, or, as in billiards, the stronger the blow, the further the balls are scattered!
